szoveg_eredeti:
Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out now – bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast task completion for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

While Carbon tackles your hardest, long-horizon projects and Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution, Neon balances depth and efficiency.

On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, it ranks #3 with a score of 61 at its xhigh thinking level.

The model is available starting now in the Gemini API in Google AI Studio , Android Studio, and Gemini for business - plus the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers as well as Google Antigravity for paid subscribers.

Find out more → https://goo.gle/4fiHbo9
